name: Baidu Cloud Service
description: Baidu Cloud API wrapper: OCR text recognition, Baidu Baike lookup, AI web search, async video notes. Dual-key auth via key_registry (bd-ocr + bd-qianfan).
description_zh: 百度云 API 封装：文字识别（OCR）、百科查询、AI 网络搜索、异步视频笔记。双凭据认证（key_registry：bd-ocr + bd-qianfan）。

credentials.name: bd-ocr
credentials.description_en: Baidu OCR API Key + Secret Key (comma-separated)
credentials.description_zh: 百度 OCR API 密钥对（api_key,secret_key）

credentials.name: bd-qianfan
credentials.description_zh: 百度千帆 Bearer 令牌

directives.usage_zh: 百度云;文字识别,<图片URL或本地路径>
directives.description: Extract text from image via Baidu OCR API. Supports URL and local file path.
directives.description_zh: 从图片中提取文字（百度 OCR API）。支持 URL 和本地文件路径。

params_desc.image: Image URL or local file path

directives.description: Look up Baidu Baike entry by keyword. Returns title, summary, and lemma ID.
directives.description_zh: 按关键词查询百度百科词条。返回标题、摘要和词条 ID。

directives.description: AI-powered web search via Baidu Qianfan. Returns ranked sources with snippets.
directives.description_zh: 通过百度千帆进行 AI 网络搜索。返回排序后的来源和摘要。

directives.description: Create AI notes from video URL (async). Returns task_id for status polling if not completed within short wait.
directives.description_zh: 从视频 URL 生成 AI 笔记（异步）。短时等待未完成时返回 task_id 供轮询。

params_desc.video_url: Video URL to generate notes from

directives.usage_zh: 百度云;视频笔记结果,<任务ID>
directives.description: Query video notes task result by task_id. Called by task-manager for async polling.
directives.description_zh: 按 task_id 查询视频笔记任务结果。由 task-manager 异步轮询调用。

params_desc.task_id: External task ID from video-notes creation
